map.：哈希将任意长度输入映射为固定长度摘要，单向不可逆、输入微小变化输出大不同（雪崩: : A hash maps an input of any length to a fixed-length digest; it is one-way and irreversible, and a tiny change in input produces a very different output (avalanche effect). MD5 outputs 128 bits (no longer recommended for security), SHA-1 outputs 160 bits (weakened), SHA-256 outputs 256 bits (currently recommended).
map.：文本 hello 的 MD5 = 5d41402abc4b2a76b9719d: : The MD5 of the text hello is 5d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c592 and the SHA-256 is 2cf24dba5fb0a30e26e83b2ac5b9e29e1b161e5c1fa7425e73043362938b9824; changing one character to hellp makes both hashes completely different, showing the avalanche effect.

map.哈希和加密有什么区别？: What is the difference between hashing and encryption?
map.哈希单向不可逆、用于校验；加密可逆、用于保密。验证文件用哈希比对，保护内容用加密: Hashing is one-way and irreversible, used for verification; encryption is reversible, used for confidentiality. Verify files with hash comparison, protect content with encryption.
map.为什么不用 MD5 做安全校验？: Why not use MD5 for security checks?
map.MD5/SHA-1 已被找到碰撞攻击，可构造不同文件同哈希；安全场景请用 SHA: Collision attacks have been found for MD5/SHA-1, so different files can be crafted with the same hash; for security use SHA-256 or stronger.
